plugins.name: ux-skills
plugins.description: Catalog-first UX on shadcn/ui: preflight gate, project decisions in ux.config.json, go/no-go rules, and a /ux-audit with Haiku reviewers

plugins.name: review-skills
plugins.description: Agent-scale code review: set up a repo's review process, run a capped pre-PR review loop, spec an issue with the user, and take it end to end to a mergeable PR

plugins.name: deps-skills
plugins.description: Weekly dependency upgrades for npm, Python, and Go: OSV CVEs and CWEs, cooldown-based targets, release-note diffs, severity with wait times, breaking-change search with Haiku, and an automated upgrade PR

plugins.name: k8s-skills
plugins.description: Kubernetes cluster upgrades for kubeadm, k3s, RKE2, Talos, EKS, GKE, and AKS: read-only scan against EOL dates, the Kubernetes CVE feed, OSV, removed APIs, and version skew; release-note risk analysis; HA preflight; issues for blockers; a GitOps PR; and a gated node-by-node upgrade

plugins.name: comm-skills
plugins.description: How Claude talks to you in long sessions: a decision brief with headline, long-term trade-offs, alternatives, and every added fallback or workaround put to you as a decision

plugins.name: software-engineering
plugins.description: Architecture judgment: design from the ideal, keep service boundaries, size every edge case before special-casing it, and an Opus proportionality-review agent that judges whether a special case is justified, plus /report to file a wrong turn as an issue on this repo
